name: Table Money
author: TheMoneyGlitch
summary: Checks a chosen date range for unsent invoices and unresolved spending, then drafts follow-up messages for your approval.
starterPrompt: Review the records I provide from the last 60 days. List unresolved invoices or payments with supporting evidence and draft follow-up messages without sending them.
usageNote: Start with redacted records. Check every amount against the original documents and approve each message before it is sent.
